s.how: Fry 8 thick slices of back bacon until golden and serve in 8 soft buns with mustard. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: the doughnut shop Bob and Doug love
s.how: Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour, cool and beat in 3 eggs. Pipe rings onto baking paper and fry at 180C until golden. Dip in 150g icing sugar mixed with 2 tbsp honey and water.

m.how: Bake 1kg frozen chips, top with 250g cubed haloumi or curds and pour over 400ml hot gravy. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Mix 100g brown sugar, 80ml maple syrup, 60g butter and 1 egg. Fill 12 small pastry cases and bake at 190C for 15 minutes. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.how: Chill 8 stubbies of lager and serve. Ginger ale for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
